endpoints.name: Delete Secondary Order

idempotency.notes: Repeating the call after success will typically return not-found or no change

endpoints.detailed_description: Delete secondary order. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ISecondaryOrder.GetSecondaryOrderById, ICommon.ToJsonString, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: soft delete (is_deleted flag), AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid lead ID is required. [when id <= 0]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.not_found: 404: Secondary Order not found. [when existingSecondaryOrder == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when current_user == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to delete secondary order
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Delete secondary order — validates the request, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, ISecondaryOrder.GetSecondaryOrderById, ICommon.ToJsonString, writes an audit log entry
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; route parameter(s) id must reference existing record(s); passes 3 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.side_effects: AuditLog DELETE (Customer Relationship Management > Secondary Orders > Secondary Order)
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
